content.text:
I fixed the contact page. The cause was the long support email address (`customer.support.team@acmestorefront.example`) in the "Other ways to reach us" card, which had no rule letting it wrap:

- **Desktop:** the address ran past the right edge of the card.
- **Phone:** it pushed the page out to 424px on a 390px screen, so the whole page scrolled sideways. The customer most likely saw this.

**Fix:** I added one rule to `site/css/pages.css`, applied only to that card's contact details:

```css
.info-list dd {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

The address now breaks onto a second line inside the card, which is how the approved screenshots show it. Nothing else on the page or the rest of the site changes.

**Verification:** before the fix, the contact page was the only one failing the screenshot comparison (desktop and phone); the other 10 checks passed. After the fix, all 28 tests pass, including the screenshot comparisons and the functional tests.

I couldn't see what yesterday's update changed: the repository has only one commit, so there's no earlier version to compare against. I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
